case_name: Richard Alan Saunders and Shelia Candy Saunders v. Commissioner

taxpayer.notes: Claimed three unrelated children (listed as niece/nephew) and wife's father Mr. Steed as dependents; $3,000 child tax credits claimed.

adjustments: disallowed child tax credits for three children
disallowed dependency exemption deductions for three children and Mr. Steed
notice_of_deficiency.contested_by_taxpayer: Child tax credits, dependency exemptions, and penalty

findings_of_fact.fact: Three children of Ms. Thomas (unrelated family friend/church member) lived with petitioners; all younger than 10 in 2012
findings_of_fact.snippet: In 2012, the three children were all younger than 10

findings_of_fact.fact: Children are not petitioners' children/descendants or siblings/descendants of siblings
findings_of_fact.snippet: The children do not bear a qualifying relationship to petitioners as defined in section 152(c).
The return shows $3,000 claimed in child tax credits.

findings_of_fact.fact: Children had no gross income; petitioners provided all support except school transport; children's residency testimony credited
findings_of_fact.snippet: The three children had no gross income, and petitioners provided all oftheir support with the exception oftransportation to and from school.

findings_of_fact.fact: Petitioners did not corroborate that Ms. Thomas released her claim to the children for 2012 (not shown children were not qualifying children of another taxpayer)
findings_of_fact.snippet: Petitioners, however, did not present evidence beyond their testimony.

findings_of_fact.fact: Mr. Steed is petitioner wife's father, not a qualifying child of any taxpayer
findings_of_fact.snippet: Mr. Steed certainly bears a qualifying relationship to petitioner wife, as defined in section 152(d)(2)(C), and is not a qualifying child of any taxpayer.

findings_of_fact.fact: Mr. Steed received SSI of $733 per month, $8,796 for 2012
findings_of_fact.snippet: Mr. Steed received during 2012 SSI of $733 per month, or $8,796 for the year
For 2012 the exemption amount pursuant to section 151(d) was $3,800.

findings_of_fact.fact: Household monthly expenses $2,880 for six persons; $80/month transport for Mr. Steed
findings_of_fact.snippet: Petitioners' monthly household expenses for 2012 totaled roughly $2,880, or $480 per member of the six-person household.

findings_of_fact.fact: Petitioners not tax experts; relied in good faith on commercial preparer with full disclosure
findings_of_fact.snippet: we find that petitioners relied reasonably and in good faith on their commercial return preparer

issues.question: Are petitioners entitled to child tax credits for the three children for 2012?
issues.holding: Not entitled: children fail the §152(c)(2) relationship test, so none is a qualifying child
issues.computable_reason: Relationship test is a mechanical check of the found relationships.

issues.question: Are petitioners entitled to dependency exemption deductions for the three children as qualifying relatives?
issues.holding: Not entitled: although household-member relationship, income and support tests appear met, petitioners failed to prove the children were not qualifying children of another taxpayer (Ms. Thomas)
issues.computable_reason: Turned on failure of proof (no corroboration that the mother released her claim / was not entitled).

issues.question: Are petitioners entitled to a dependency exemption deduction for Mr. Steed (petitioner wife's father)?
issues.holding: Not entitled: Mr. Steed's 2012 income of $8,796 exceeds the $3,800 exemption amount, failing the gross income test

amount_determined.description: Mr. Steed's SSI vs exemption amount

issues.computable_reason: Gross income test: $8,796 > $3,800 exemption amount (as the court applied it).

issues.question: Are petitioners liable for the section 6662(a) accuracy-related penalty for 2012?
issues.holding: Not liable: reasonable cause and good faith, including reliance on commercial return preparer
issues.computable_reason: Decided on reasonable cause / good faith.

decision.text: Decision will be entered for respondent as to the deficiency and for petitioners as to the section 6662 accuracy-related penalty.
decision.summary: $4,018 deficiency sustained (no CTC, no dependency exemptions); no 6662(a) penalty.

notes: Court counted Mr. Steed's SSI as gross income for the 151(d)/152(d)(1)(B) test (modeller caution: SSI is generally not includible in gross income; the court's holding nonetheless rests on $8,796 > $3,800). Footnote 6 notes support test unclear: derived per-month petitioner support $560 vs his $733 SSI. Children's residency testimony found credible (fn. 5). Burden on petitioners; 7491(a) not raised.
